1) GAN2GAN can learn a generative model of the noise in the single noisy image, and 2) GAN2GAn can train a strong denoiser for the single noisy image with the learned generative model, and it can achieve an impressive denoiser performance that is close to that of the discriminatively trained denoiser or the N2N trained denoiser, which has more information than GAN2GAN.

our GAN2GEN method is the first to demonstrate that the blind image denoiser trained only with a single noisy image achieves a competitive performance with the standard discriminatively-learned and the N2N-trained ones, which are trained with the additional information about the clean images and/or the noisy images.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the blind denoiser can be trained with a single noisy image, by leveraging a generative model for the noise and clean image estimation.

the generative model can be effectively utilized to train a blind denoiser, even with only single distinct noisy image for a clean image, and the trained denoiser can be applied to real noisy images without any further tuning.

the generative model, trained with a single distinct noisy image, can simulate the noise in it and can generate the rough noisy estimate of the underlying clean image, which are then used to train the denoiser in the N2N fashion, leading to an impressive denoiser performance.
